# Public test material

`oidc-test-key.der` is the published RSA test key from jsonwebtoken 10.4.0
(`tests/rsa/private_rsa_key.der`), used only to sign local regression fixtures.
It is not a credential and must never configure a deployed provider.

Source: https://github.com/Keats/jsonwebtoken/tree/v10.4.0/tests/rsa
